notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at the father of Abd al-Warith (written «أبي» in branch 2). The grandfather «جدي» and what follows are written once and form the shared tail. Abd al-Samad is not merged with «أبي» (rule 9).
«أخبرني أبو سلمة أن عطاء ... أخبره أن زيد ... أخبره أنه سأل عثمان»: each asker is a link (rule 5). Uthman's «سمعته من رسول الله» makes him last.
